headline: Weathered Expanse Churns Under Fire as Linn of Mercy Reignites
war_summary: Since the midday edition, the violent upheaval in Weathered Expanse has only intensified, recording six fresh base transfers across the last two hours centered on Frostmarch as combined casualties surged beyond four thousand. Linn of Mercy has reignited following earlier lulls, logging two rapid base exchanges at Lathair amidst an abrupt acceleration in butcher bills. Conversely, base movement has ground to a halt across Mooring County, though heavy fighting continues to produce over seventeen hundred casualties across the two-hour window. The island theaters have notably cooled; Godcrofts concluded its contested transfers with Colonials securing all nine strategic positions, while Fisherman's Row settled into near-total stillness with fewer than a dozen casualties reported. Fierce grinding attrition persists along dormant frontlines elsewhere, with Callahan's Passage absorbing over thirty-five hundred casualties, Stonecradle generating more than twenty-two hundred, and Nevish Line accelerating rapidly, all without dislodging established parapets.
